checks.name: test
checks.command: cd remy/api && uv run --package remy-api pytest -q tests/features/calculator

checks.name: lint
checks.command: cd remy/api && uv run --package remy-api ruff check src/api/features/calculator --select F,E9

checks.name: typecheck
checks.command: cd remy/api && uv run --package remy-api mypy src/api/features/calculator --ignore-missing-imports
